dedupe_keys.name: nicter darknet observation live statistics and annual reports of cyber attack traffic nict japan

description: NICTER is NICT's cyber attack observation and analysis system, which monitors a large darknet of unused IP addresses to understand the overall trends of indiscriminate cyber attacks; traffic arriving at such addresses comes largely from scanning by malware-infected devices. The NICTERWEB site publishes part of the observation results every day: Atlas animates packets reaching the darknet on a world map by address and port, Cube shows them in a three-dimensional view, Stats gives time series of observation statistics at 5-minute, hourly and daily steps, and Top10 lists daily top ten statistics for about the previous three months. NICT also publishes an annual NICTER observation report summarising attacks seen on its darknet and honeypots, with editions from 2016 to 2025 (released on 5 February 2026), and occasional analyses such as one on residential proxies abusing home IoT devices (July 2026). Coverage: global sources observed from NICT's darknet. Format and access: web visualisations, statistics pages and PDF reports, free. Caveats: darknet traffic shows scanning and backscatter, not attacks on specific infrastructure; the darknet size and sensor details were not read. Simulation uses: scan and botnet activity trends as threat inputs for cyber scenario models of networked infrastructure, including exposed IoT devices. Related records: JPCERT/CC reports and TSUBAME give incident and sensor views, and the CAIDA UCSD network telescope is a comparable darknet source.
name: NICTER darknet observation: live statistics and annual reports of cyber attack traffic (NICT, Japan)
